text:
Liam: Canary spike this morning: cold-start token latency 2.5x for a bundle using delta-sidecar.
Rosa: Which bundle?
Liam: s3://redwood-canary/deltas/exp-2025-02-11/{sha}.safetensors + .delta sidecar.
kyle: I think warmup uses the precomputed index but sidecar deltas shift byte offsets until applied. Warmup aborts -> stream fallback.
Yuki: Local repro confirms. Warmup tried to map offsets into base file and missed.
Priya: We have three approaches: eager apply delta at mount, let warmup operate against base+delta virtual offsets, or export a final_index sidecar that points at post-patch layout.
Rosa: Ops prefers final_index sidecar since eager patching wastes IO on large models. Final_index lets warmup prefetch correct ranges without mutating files.
kyle: Exporter should produce .final.index and a checksum. Loader will read final.index for warmup but apply delta lazily on first read. Coalesce ranges to avoid tiny IO.
Yuki: Edge-case: if final.index references many tiny segments, prefetch will be inefficient. Exporter coalescing rule: merge adjacent ranges up to 512KB span, max gap 64KB.
Priya: Add header.delta_hotpath = "final_index"|"apply_eager"|"none" and header.final_index_checksum. Default missing->legacy stream-first heuristic.
Liam: Security: final.index must be authenticated (signed or checksummed). Runtime should reject mismatches and fallback.
Rosa: Ops request: add deploy flag "allow_delta_sidecars" to gate rollout in Dedicated clusters.
kyle: Pseudocode for loader warmup path:
```python
meta = read_header(p)
if meta.get('delta_hotpath') == 'final_index' and exists(p + '.final.index'):
  idx = read_final_index(p + '.final.index')
  ranges = coalesce(idx, max_gap=64*1024, max_span=512*1024)
  prefetch(ranges)
else:
  stream_warmup()
```
Yuki: Canary criteria: 95p warmup latency improves >=30% and IO error rate stable for 24h.
Priya: Action items: Priya -> RFC draft (today). kyle -> loader prototype & tests. Yuki -> canary metrics. Rosa -> ops flag + rollout plan.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: delta-hotpath-test, warmup-metrics enabled.
Rosa: Also document migration path for on-prem customers who transform models in place (regenerate final.index after transforms).
Liam: Will open PR and link here. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
